title: Sturdy storage baskets
text: Sturdy storage baskets. These are very sturdy with hard sides that don’t collapse or buckle in. I got beige and it’s a nice shade with no yellow undertone.

product_metadata.title: SimpleHouseware Fabric Cube Storage Bins Foldable Organizer, Geometric Grey, Set of 6
features: Collapsible bins with stylish design to save on space when not in use.
5 heavy cardboards (include bottom side) support each side for every bin
Lightweight and sturdy boxes perfect for organization
Easy access with the fabric drawer handle, compliments with cube storage organizer
Dimension: 11" H x 10.75" W x 10.75" D
